title: The Agent Attack Surface
youtube_title: The Agent Attack Surface: Prompt Injection and the Lethal Trifecta | The Agentic Crew, Ch 10
description: To a language model, data and instructions are the same tokens, so anyone who can put text in front of your agent can steer it. This chapter explains prompt injection, the lethal trifecta of private data, untrusted content and a way out, and the layered defences that keep a tricked agent from doing real harm.
